task_summary: Extract invoice data from PDF, cross-reference against vendor and PO databases, detect fraud based on 5 priority-ordered criteria, and output flagged invoices as JSON.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct functional domains: (1) PDF text extraction and field parsing, (2) reference data ingestion from Excel/CSV, and (3) cross-reference fraud detection logic with fuzzy matching. Combining extraction and parsing into one skill, data loading into another, and the fraud detection pipeline into a third keeps responsibilities cleanly separated while maintaining manageable complexity.

skills.name: evo-pdf-invoice-parser
skills.description: Extracts text from each page of a PDF invoice file using pdfplumber and parses structured fields (vendor name, IBAN, PO number, invoice amount) using regular expressions. Handles whitespace normalization, locale-specific amount formats, and spaced IBANs.
skills.responsibility: PDF text extraction and regex-based field parsing for invoice data. Returns a list of parsed invoice records with page numbers.
dr_sections: 2. PDF Text Extraction Mechanisms: pdfplumber vs. pypdf
3. Parsing Invoice Fields via Regular Expressions

skills.name: evo-reference-data-loader
skills.description: Loads and normalizes vendor master data from Excel (.xlsx) and purchase order data from CSV. Handles dtype management, whitespace stripping, and creates lookup dictionaries for downstream cross-referencing.
skills.responsibility: Ingesting, cleaning, and structuring reference data from vendors.xlsx and purchase_orders.csv into Python dictionaries suitable for lookup operations.
dr_sections: 4. Ingesting Reference Data: pandas and openpyxl
4.1 Excel File Ingestion using openpyxl (openpyxl 3.1.5, pandas 2.3.3)

skills.name: evo-invoice-fraud-detector
skills.description: Implements the full fraud detection pipeline: fuzzy-matches vendor names against the vendor database using rapidfuzz, then applies the 5 priority-ordered fraud checks (Unknown Vendor, IBAN Mismatch, Invalid PO, Amount Mismatch, Vendor Mismatch). Outputs flagged invoices as a JSON report.
skills.responsibility: Fuzzy vendor matching, priority-ordered fraud rule evaluation, and JSON report generation. Orchestrates parsed invoice data against reference data to produce the final fraud_report.json.
dr_sections: 5.2 Scorer Selection for Corporate Entity Names
6. Output Formatting and Serialization via JSON
7. Data Pipeline Architectural Patterns for Fraud Detection
